rows.meaning: causing fear or loss of confidence
rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that causes fear or makes people lose their nerve.

example.english: That horror film is really unnerving.
example.traditional: 嗰套恐怖片真係好嚇人。
example.jyutping: go2 tou3 hung2 bou3 pin2 zan1 hai6 hou2 haak3 jan4

rows.meaning: causing fear or loss of confidence
rows.note: Use this when the situation creates a persistent feeling of unease rather than immediate fear.

example.english: Walking through that alley alone at night is always unnerving.
example.traditional: 夜晚一個人行過嗰條巷，總係令人不安。
example.jyutping: je6 maan5 jat1 go3 jan4 haang4 gwo3 go2 tiu4 hong6 zung2 hai6 ling6 jan4 bat1 on1

rows.meaning: causing fear or loss of confidence
rows.note: Use this specifically when something undermines confidence or morale and leaves people discouraged.

example.english: Being criticized all the time is really unnerving.
example.traditional: 成日俾人批評，真係令人洩氣。
example.jyutping: seng4 jat6 bei2 jan4 pai1 ping4 zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 sit3 hei3
